_note: WO-AEO-ENGINE-COUNT-CURRENCY-008: the single source for which engines each plan asks. Lint L-ENGINE-1 (scripts/lint-engine-count.mjs) checks published copy against it. Changing a panel starts with a lint failure listing every line to revisit.
citationSweepAccess: Paid only: the Day Pass, or a Pro or Business subscription. No free tier includes a sweep.

aeoScore.what: A structural scan of the website (a different product from Citation Sweeps).
aeoScore.engines: Powered by Google Gemini (one model answers each analysis; OpenAI and Anthropic are fallbacks when Gemini is unavailable). The free score excludes the fixes.

canonical: Pro and Business ask five answer engines: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Grok. The no-subscription Day Pass asks four.
short: five answer engines on Pro and Business, four on the Day Pass
museLine: Meta's Muse launched in September 2026 as a task agent. We are evaluating it for the panel on the same terms as the others: asked directly, with web search enabled, and every answer stored with its transcript.

museCheck.result: Meta Model API offers Muse Spark with a built-in web_search tool on the Responses API that returns url_citation annotations (url, title).
